conceptBlocks.text: 采购行是履约计数单位，收货件数是质量计量单位。

items: 准时足量率=承诺日及之前累计合格数量达到订购量的采购行数÷到期采购行数；完整交付率=截至年底累计合格数量达到订购量的采购行数÷到期采购行数；质量合格率=合格件数÷实际收货件数。
分批收货不能按收货单数计履约；零实收时质量率留空。

syntax.purpose: 供应商履约率与交付表现的语法模板如下，各部分含义见下方说明。

problem: 采购主管希望比较各供应商是否按承诺日期交足合格商品、截至年底是否最终交齐，以及到货质量是否稳定。统计2025年承诺到期的非取消采购行，截止2025-12-31；尚未到期的采购行不进入分母。

methodBlocks.text: 原主查询使用已汇总至采购行的 v_po_lines，按承诺日期选择2025年到期采购行。
每行的 on_time 是承诺日前（含当日）合格件数，accepted 是截止日合格件数，received 是截止日实收件数。用 CASE 产生0或1，再按供应商汇总；
两项交付率以 COUNT(*) 为分母，质量率用合格总件数除以实收总件数，不平均各行质量率。构造该视图时，先把收货按采购行汇总，无收货以零计；
截止日条件放在左连接或收货汇总内部，不能在外层 WHERE 删除无收货行。到齐日期先按日合计合格数量，再累计并取第一次达到订购量的日期。未到齐保留空日期，逾期以截止日减承诺日；
提前到齐按零天处理。独立例子假设所有采购行均有效且到期、收货数量及合格数量非负。

breakdown.title: 为到期采购行标记准时及到齐
breakdown.sql:
SELECT po_item_id,supplier_id,quantity_ordered,received,accepted,
 CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ontime_flag,
 CASE WHEN accepted>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS complete_flag
FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 为到期采购行标记准时及到齐（due_line_flags）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

breakdown.title: 按供应商累计行数、收货及接收数量
breakdown.sql:
SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) AS due_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ontime_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN accepted>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complete_lines,
 SUM(accepted) AS accepted_units,SUM(received) AS received_units
FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 按供应商累计行数、收货及接收数量（supplier_totals）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

completeCode.mysqlSql: SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) due_lines,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) ontime_pct,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN accepted>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) complete_pct,ROUND(100.0*SUM(accepted)/NULLIF(SUM(received),0),2) quality_pct FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY due_lines DESC, ontime_pct DESC, complete_pct DESC, quality_pct DESC
completeCode.sqliteSql: SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) due_lines,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) ontime_pct,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN accepted>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) complete_pct,ROUND(100.0*SUM(accepted)/NULLIF(SUM(received),0),2) quality_pct FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY due_lines DESC, ontime_pct DESC, complete_pct DESC, quality_pct DESC

resultBlocks.text: 教学数据中供应商1有3条到期行，仅第1行准时足量，准时率1÷3=33.33%；第1和第2行最终交齐，完整率2÷3=66.67%；实收21件、合格20件，质量率95.24%。
供应商2有2条到期行，准时和完整率均为50%，实收8件全部合格，质量率100%。质量好不代表没有交付延误。第2行迟5天到齐；第3、5行截止日未到齐，逾期11天。
原企业结果供应商1共53条到期行，准时49.06%、完整86.79%、质量99.86%；这些为原结果预览，未在本次重新执行。应结合订单规模、缺货影响和拒收原因判断改善优先级。

extensions.label: 分批收货汇总

explanationBlocks.text: 截止日限制放在左连接条件中，保留无收货记录。第一行实收11件，合格10件；第二行承诺日前仅合格4件。

extensions.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(line_id,supplier_id,ordered,promised) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(2,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(3,1,5,'2025-12-20'),(4,2,8,'2025-12-20'),(5,2,4,'2025-12-20')
), receipts(line_id,receipt_date,received,accepted) AS (
 VALUES (1,'2025-12-05',6,6),(1,'2025-12-10',5,4),(2,'2025-12-09',4,4),(2,'2025-12-15',6,6),(4,'2025-12-20',8,8),(5,'2026-01-02',4,4)
), totals AS (
 SELECT p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised,
 COALESCE(SUM(r.received),0) received,COALESCE(SUM(r.accepted),0) accepted,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.receipt_date<=p.promised THEN r.accepted ELSE 0 END),0) on_time
 FROM purchase_lines p LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.line_id=p.line_id AND r.receipt_date<='2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised
) SELECT line_id,ordered,received,accepted,on_time FROM totals ORDER BY ordered DESC, received DESC

extensions.label: 逐行判断履约

explanationBlocks.text: 分别判断准时足量和截止日完整，迟到但最终到齐属于完整而非准时。

extensions.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(line_id,supplier_id,ordered,promised) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(2,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(3,1,5,'2025-12-20'),(4,2,8,'2025-12-20'),(5,2,4,'2025-12-20')
), receipts(line_id,receipt_date,received,accepted) AS (
 VALUES (1,'2025-12-05',6,6),(1,'2025-12-10',5,4),(2,'2025-12-09',4,4),(2,'2025-12-15',6,6),(4,'2025-12-20',8,8),(5,'2026-01-02',4,4)
), totals AS (
 SELECT p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised,
 COALESCE(SUM(r.received),0) received,COALESCE(SUM(r.accepted),0) accepted,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.receipt_date<=p.promised THEN r.accepted ELSE 0 END),0) on_time
 FROM purchase_lines p LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.line_id=p.line_id AND r.receipt_date<='2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised
) SELECT line_id,CASE WHEN on_time>=ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS timely,CASE WHEN accepted>=ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS complete FROM totals ORDER BY timely DESC, complete DESC

extensions.label: 完整供应商履约报表

explanationBlocks.text: 行数作为两项履约率的分母，质量合格率使用实际收货件数。

extensions.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(line_id,supplier_id,ordered,promised) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(2,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(3,1,5,'2025-12-20'),(4,2,8,'2025-12-20'),(5,2,4,'2025-12-20')
), receipts(line_id,receipt_date,received,accepted) AS (
 VALUES (1,'2025-12-05',6,6),(1,'2025-12-10',5,4),(2,'2025-12-09',4,4),(2,'2025-12-15',6,6),(4,'2025-12-20',8,8),(5,'2026-01-02',4,4)
), totals AS (
 SELECT p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised,
 COALESCE(SUM(r.received),0) received,COALESCE(SUM(r.accepted),0) accepted,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.receipt_date<=p.promised THEN r.accepted ELSE 0 END),0) on_time
 FROM purchase_lines p LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.line_id=p.line_id AND r.receipt_date<='2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised
) SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) due_lines,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) ontime_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN accepted>=ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) complete_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(accepted)/NULLIF(SUM(received),0),2) quality_pct
 FROM totals GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY due_lines

extensions.label: 到齐日期与逾期天数

explanationBlocks.text: 先按日聚合，再累计合格件数；未到齐以截止日计算逾期。准时到齐显示零天。

comparison.text: 准时率与完整率按采购行计数；质量率按件数加权；到齐日期不同于首次收货日期。

example.text: 仅统计有收货的采购行，或将首次收货日期视作到齐日期。

correction.text: 保留无收货行，累计合格件数至订购量并核对承诺日期。
